mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (2010-2014 data).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0% (2010-2014 data).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicate strong consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth and positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month moving averages (2010-2014 data).

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation environments (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation < 2.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS rises (2010-2014 data).

mechanism_narrative: High non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 3-year average (2010-2014 data).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 (2010-2014 data).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) below their 3-month moving averages signal broad economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 fall below 3-month moving averages (2010-2014 data).

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST > 900 thousand units), strong retail sales (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) amplify consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: housing boom and strong retail sales
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 900 and RSAFS > 400000 (2010-2014 data).
